items.description:
Capture of the 1991 video "B-17 Flying Fortress - The Story Of The American Airforce In Europe" by Windsong/La Mancha.

Captured in OBS using a GV-USB2, upscaled to 640x480 using Lanczos scaling, deinterlaced with Yadif 2x.
